_comment: Overlay on top of the real assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json (Mojang, copied via extract_assets.sh). Only Melon's own keys that vanilla doesn't have.
melon.options.title: Melon Settings...
melon.options.speakerLayout.tooltip: Which speakers sounds are panned across. Auto uses what the output device prefers. Falls back to the device's own channels if it does not take the chosen ones. Directional Audio always uses stereo.
melon.debug.options.missing.tooltip: Melon does not have this yet, so it shows nothing.
melon.options.presentMode.auto.tooltip: Follows VSync: FIFO when on, otherwise Immediate, or Mailbox if that is missing.
melon.options.presentMode.fifo.tooltip: Waits for the display refresh. No tearing; queued frames add latency.
melon.options.presentMode.mailbox.toolti: Synced to the display, no tearing; the newest finished frame is shown and older ones are dropped. Low latency at an uncapped framerate.
melon.options.presentMode.immediate.tool: Shows each frame at once. Lowest latency, may tear. In a window, Windows may still composite it.
melon.options.presentMode.fifoLatestRead: Like FIFO, but at each refresh shows the newest finished frame instead of the oldest queued one. No tearing, less latency than FIFO. Needs a driver with VK_KHR_present_mode_fifo_latest_ready.
melon.options.vsync.tooltip: Ignored while the Present Mode is not Auto.
melon.pumpkin.unsupported.world_type: Pumpkin can only generate the Default world type yet, so this world can't be created.
melon.pumpkin.unsupported.structures: Pumpkin always generates structures; this can't be switched off yet.
melon.pumpkin.unsupported.bonus_chest: Pumpkin can't place a bonus chest at the spawn yet.
melon.pumpkin.unsupported.customize: Pumpkin has no world type settings to customize yet.
melon.worldOptions.onlineMode.tooltip: Guests must sign in with their Microsoft account (Java) or Xbox account (Bedrock). Off, anyone can join under any name.
melon.worldOptions.bedrock.tooltip: Lets Bedrock Edition players join over the LAN as well, at the Bedrock port.
melon.worldOptions.bedrockPort.tooltip: The port Bedrock players join at, over UDP and TCP. Leave it empty for Bedrock's default, 19132.
melon.worldOptions.publish.bedrock: Bedrock players can join at port %s
